name: B10-0397/2025 (PPE) – Case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Victoire Ingabire, a Rwandan opposition politician arrested again in June 2025. It says her arrest is part of a pattern of political persecution. It asks Rwanda to stop harassing opponents, pay her the money a court ordered, and let her take part in politics. The Parliament is not passing a law here. It is stating its opinion and putting pressure on Rwanda.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Victoire Ingabire, her supporters, and Rwanda's government.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to Rwandan and African Union leaders, who decide whether to act.
